answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a proof-of-work bond: every miner must burn real compute to produce a valid receipt before it can mine at all. Minting a fake identity is free, a valid receipt is not, so a crowd of puppets each needs its own paid work, and the attacker's bill rises linearly with every synthetic agent while reward stays split across the whole river of accounts. Each fake receipt burns the same energy as an honest one, so flooding the garden with clones costs strictly more per unit of reward than running one node, leaving no velvet path to profit.
